root_cause.admission: Legacy _map_games_to_local_game_ids used game_info.game_date plus home/away teams to replace official gamePk.
root_cause.other_branches: No evidence the prior-night ID came from StatsAPI date-range construction, cache, or source schedule. Earlier retained 05:30 official schedule contains all 15 intended IDs; original manual response was not saved.

authoritative_identity: aware scheduled start UTC with matching PT date
behavior.prewrite_foreign_or_offdate_rows: EXCLUDED_BY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIED_ID_SET; duplicate or malformed row keys fail closed
behavior.starter_unresolved: SKIP_TEAM_SIDE; retain exact game/team/opponent/pitcher-null identities and fallback reason
behavior.auditing: Exclusive private per-acquisition JSONL journal, fsync before admission, successful/failed request identity, empty payload plus response hash, later database-commit marker; actual timestamps only.
behavior.empty_semantics: Successful verified empty stats/splits retained with request identity; never claim certified zero history or manufacture zero feature rows. Invalid empty shape classified EMPTY_BVP_RESPONSE_UNVERIFIABLE.
behavior.new_reader_admission: Canonical membership from retained official archives, immutable Moneyline slate, or committed forward source journal. New captures additionally require committed batter/pitcher/tag/hash/pregame receipt. Unknown/ambiguous authority and quarantined keys fail closed.
behavior.legacy_compatibility: Legacy rows are preserved; only game identity can be certified, not absent original pitcher/as-of lineage.

historical_scope.causal_limits: Retention is a mutable latest-row population, not a full acquisition ledger. Date cohorts are not run counts. Retrospective schedule archives contain reschedules/postponements; 8021 is not a proven causal count for this mapper. The scheduled April 15 counter and retained prior-night rows show this is not manual-only. Earlier April boundary fingerprints lack full original run provenance.

downstream.actual_consumption_status: UNRESOLVED_FOR_ALL_HISTORICAL_RUNS; 53 prior-day training keys existed before manual acquisition, but no stored feature-copy provenance demonstrates consumption of the 91 later rows. Legacy feature loader discarded source-row identity. No blanket historical nonconsumption claim.

september18.starter_skip_identity_status: UNRECOVERABLE_AT_MANUAL_TIMESTAMP. Earlier 05:30 schedule missing BAL/COL home starters is not substituted for actual manual response; two missing current keys do not prove two starter-skip games.
september18.fixture_note: Actual retained batter-game keys and earlier official schedule identities; synthetic feature values explicitly labelled, not a prediction rerun or repaired data.

validation.protected_ledgers: No task writes; natural scheduled daily runs may update operational/passive artifacts independently during this task.

rollback: With separate approval revert only this correction commit; no database row rollback, source re-acquisition, rekey, deletion, schedule/power/service change.
